title: uswf-collins-1998-heavyweight
label: Tiger

won.source: The fed's own Made In America pay-per-view recap: Tiger pins Shane Johnson in the tournament final after The Rebel's chair interference.

how: Won a one-night, eight-man tournament, defeating The Rebel, Dave Martens and Shane Johnson (the last with a top-rope Victory Roll after The Rebel struck Johnson with a chair) in a single show.
note: Still champion at the held record's end.

title: uswf-collins-1998-tagteam
label: The Dominators

won.source: The fed's own Made In America pay-per-view recap: The Dominators defeat Voices In Your Head with their finisher, Total Domination, in a restarted tag-title tournament final.

how: Won a tag-team tournament final against Voices In Your Head that ran past its own 30-minute time limit and was restarted.
note: Still champions at the held record's end.
